goal: Remove mobile network away_mode for stayconnected and make pairing codes alphanumeric

steps.title: Disable mobile network relay (away_mode) in maclink-core, node config, and CLI
steps.note: Disabled away_mode in node.rs, config.rs, CLI, and FFI; enforced RelayMode::Disabled and LAN/USB only; cargo check -p maclink-core passed cleanly.

steps.title: Remove mobile network stay-connected toggles in desktop and Android UI & settings
steps.note: Removed mobile network awayMode toggle row from SettingsPage.qml, set away_mode to always return false in desktop settings.rs, removed mobile data switch in Android SettingsScreen.kt, and locked awayMode to false in Core.kt. Desktop check passed cleanly.

steps.title: Update SAS derivation and protocol in maclink-protocol to generate alphanumeric codes
steps.note: Updated sas_code in maclink-protocol/src/pairing.rs to generate 6-character unambiguous alphanumeric codes using SAS_ALPHANUMERIC_CHARS. All 62 tests passed.

steps.title: Update pairing logic and UI inputs across desktop and Android to accept alphanumeric pairing codes
steps.note: Updated pairing bridge, CodeDigits components, and docs. Verified end-to-end nearby pairing with alphanumeric codes via test nearby_pairing_with_matching_codes (passed).

steps.title: Verify with unit tests (without building apps), commit to git, and push to remote
